content: Takayeiluw ven Gelasin waseg
Idopels ineis palatan, ilugs ven Gelasin waseg.
Yeisuw ibus, in wanakaew, mo takayeiluw teitan isap, imek. Bo ilisow alawag towen takunumwan, inoun imek Yeisuw.

Taw towen nag ivag nabunatum, immasisa wakalawag. Nag teitan gamag kadilok bitawtoun biyous taw towen, biyawen sen waseg. Tut babaw niyawwanis sen waseg o kaken nikiptukwes amweilok waseg, tage ivatay, iwlitun sen, iwut amweilok kaken waseg mo isawl. Tut babaw ma̱wan-wan. Nag teitan gamag kadilok vayuwein biyous.
Mapuna nises wakalawag o wa̱koy, biwkuwak-wana beiyam oko beiboug, mo biwekey dakul bikow, tatonena-wan biwaway wa̱won.
Tage Yeisuw ilug im, ikin kadiveiyov, isawl im, bikulul kid wamatan.
Aygan avakaein iwak, ilana, “Aveiyag bukunuwakeig Yeisuw, ya̱koum Tamam Yowbad walba̱lab. Kunuway Tamam; mata kuweig, ke?”
Anilivan ma̱wan peinan Yeisuw bo idibek yeiluw bilisow kid gamag towen, binoun.
Yeisuw ikatigan yeiluw ilana, “Yeiluw ya̱koum, amiyagam?” Iw to yeiluw, ilana, “Yagag Kamimet, peinan meiveka yakamey ka̱siw nakases.”
Mo igilagel waseg Yeisuw, ilana, “Awoum kwayabem bakan kadiveiyov.”
Tage bwaloud babaw ikamkwams awuyow wa̱koy.
Siyas yeiluw igilagels, ilansa, “Kwayabem bakan bwaloud wanuwes.”
Itam, ilana, “Kuweis.” Iweis gog, isiws wanuwes bwaloud, mo isisawls, ineis koy tigtageg waseg mo ikalka̱louws inineis wayvagam, iwgweles, bwaloud singay babaw, mamagina akweiy tawsan.
Tasiyas gog tamtakavateins aleis, isawls, ikamteles youd towen wawnovek o vena babaw wasigeis. Iliganes gamag babaw, bisaps kid bineis ikines.
Isaps, inekes Yeisuw, ikines towen takayeiluw bo ibwein, bo isikam anakweim, nissin wadadan. Bo iyow nuwes peinan ikakins yeiluw babaw neisiws wanuwan taw towen; nagein gog bo ibwein.
Gamag mwasanin nisesus, ikines takayeiluw bo ibwein, yeiluw mo iyagages bwaloud, wankuyeim mo ikamteles gamag tasiyas mwana nimeis.
Iliganes tasiyas mo igilagels waseg Yeisuw sivines bilisow siven, binoun.
Mapuna itouw wa̱wag, bo beiyum. Toge takayeiluw mtowen mwana neibwein igilagel waseg Yeisuw, sivinan kid sona bineis.
Yeisuw gog ipiyev, ilana “Nag. Bweina kuyum kun wamven, kudibakes talawom mo bikakins ama̱wan daGuyaws nikalin nuwan waseg ya̱koum, ilabeim.”
Iligen, iyum, in ika̱mat ama̱wan nivkek Yeisuw nileb. Wawnuwan ven towen Dekapolis gamag babaw iliganes, mo isom ninous.
Vinay asteiy ibweins
Yeisuw siney navamul idopels, iyums ineis palatan; babaw gamag iliganes, ikatuyouns imekes Yeisuw, igaw nises walasin yevagam avakaein.
Isap tanuwagan sinagog teitan, yagan Yelos, ikin Yeisuw, ikulul avakaein wamatan, igilagel, ilana, “Natug kuda̱vin ankatoun avakaein. Kum kusen namam wa̱won kuyamov.”
Yeisuw itam, mo inounas ineis son taw towen. Singay babaw gamag ibwa̱kuns waseg, ipapeps wa̱won.
Inounas, na̱tan vin nakatoun inek Yeisuw. Ankatoun peinan buya̱vin iwta̱wout sinawatan kweiy bweilim; nag imda̱mad.
Doket babaw iyyokons, bo nag. Vin na̱wen namoney igimwelena bo iyakous; tage doket tasiyas nag ilabes bwein vin mana̱wen, ankatoun bo ivakaeina singay.
Mana̱wen vin bo iligen bulagan Yeisuw, isiw wanuwan gamag babaw, ikikun ee... mo ikabkwen anakweim matan.
Idoki misinaka bikabkwen anakweim matan mo beibwein.
Ikabkwen, nuwanaw mo imad buya̱vin; isimkwen wa̱won, ikakina bo ibwein.
Tage Yeisuw isimkwen natawtoun bo ilisow won, itouvin wanuwein gamag babaw, ilana, “Kal ikabkwen agukweim?”
Iweis navamul, ilansa, “Gamag singay babaw ipapeps wa̱wom. Aveiyag wawun kulana, ‘Kal ikabkwaneig’?”
Tage Yeisuw ivvatus gamag babaw, bikin kid kal nikabkwen.
Vin mana̱wen ikakina bo ibwein won, anpwa̱yat seikwan, tage inek Yeisuw, ikulul wamatan, ikamtel anilivan iyakous.
Iwa̱ge Yeisuw, idibek ilana, “Vin ya̱koum, nukusimounid waseg yey, mapuna bo kubwein. Mwa̱saw waseg kunoun, peinan amkwatoun bo ikous.”
Igawa illivan, teitan gog gamag meinoy neim tanuwagan sinagog wanbunatum, idibek, ilana, “Natum bo ikanig. Awoum kweitan wotet kusek takatimlakay towen.”
Yeisuw gog iligen, idibek tanuwagan sinagog, ilana, “Awoum bikubukub nuwam, bweina bukusimounid.”
Yeisuw ilana, “Awoum kumeis tababaw yakamiy. Bweina yey sigwey gunavamul tasiyas Pita, Yemes son bwadan Yon, o gwad taman. Misinaka amateinim.”
Isaps tanuwagan sinagog wanven, ikines tavva̱lams ivva̱lams, talloupids illoupids, ages avakaein. Isiw, ilana, “Aveiyag wawun kuvva̱lams, agamiy avakaein? Gwad na̱wen na-ikanig; immasis-wan.”
Tasiyas gog igagigs issiba̱wes. Yeisuw mo idibakes babaw bineis watoulan; misinaka gwad taman inan, sisiyas navamul asteitoun sisiy binekes gwad nimsik-yay.
Yeisuw inek gwad towen, iyous naman, ilana, “Talita koum.” (Takativini gog bein aga-Muyuw, mamagina, “Gwade, adibakeim kukit.”)
Gwad na̱wen nuwanaw itamanaw inoun, anbweilim mamagina sinawatan kweiy. Ikines, singay isom ninous tasiyas.
To go Yeisuw anilivan tawtoun idibakes, ilana, “Awoum kwamteles youd towen”, mo ilana, “Kan kusekes nitumiy beikam.”
